commands:
nft add table inet f2b-table
nft -- add chain inet f2b-table f2b-chain \{ type filter hook input priority -1 \; \}
nft add set inet f2b-table <addr_set> \{ type <addr_type>\;<sp>flags interval\; \}
if [ 'tcp' != "all" ]; then
for proto in $(echo 'tcp' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do
nft add rule inet f2b-table f2b-chain $proto dport \{ $(echo 'http,https' | sed s/:/-/g) \} <addr_family> saddr @<addr_set> reject
done
else
nft add rule inet f2b-table f2b-chain th dport \{ $(echo 'http,https' | sed s/:/-/g) \} <addr_family> saddr @<addr_set> reject
fi

{ nft flush set inet f2b-table <addr_set> 2> /dev/null; } || {
{ nft -a list chain inet f2b-table f2b-chain | sed -nE 's/.*@<addr_set>\s+.*\s+\#\s*(handle\s+[0-9]+)$/\1/p'; } | while read -r hdl; do
nft delete rule inet f2b-table f2b-chain $hdl; done
nft delete set inet f2b-table <addr_set>
nft add set inet f2b-table <addr_set> \{ type <addr_type>\;<sp>flags interval\; \}
if [ 'tcp' != "all" ]; then
for proto in $(echo 'tcp' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do
nft add rule inet f2b-table f2b-chain $proto dport \{ $(echo 'http,https' | sed s/:/-/g) \} <addr_family> saddr @<addr_set> reject
done
else
nft add rule inet f2b-table f2b-chain th dport \{ $(echo 'http,https' | sed s/:/-/g) \} <addr_family> saddr @<addr_set> reject
fi
}
nft list chain inet f2b-table f2b-chain | grep -q '@<addr_set>[ \t]'

printf %b "Subject: [Fail2Ban] nginx-limit-req: started on <fq-hostname>
Date: `LC_ALL=C date +"%a, %d %h %Y %T %z"`
From: Fail2Ban <root@<fq-hostname>>
To: a@b.c\n
Hi,\n
The jail nginx-limit-req has been started successfully.\n
Regards,\n
Fail2Ban" | /usr/sbin/sendmail -f "root@<fq-hostname>" "a@b.c"

printf %b "Subject: [Fail2Ban] nginx-limit-req: stopped on <fq-hostname>
Date: `LC_ALL=C date +"%a, %d %h %Y %T %z"`
From: Fail2Ban <root@<fq-hostname>>
To: a@b.c\n
Hi,\n
The jail nginx-limit-req has been stopped.\n
Regards,\n
Fail2Ban" | /usr/sbin/sendmail -f "root@<fq-hostname>" "a@b.c"

printf %b "Subject: [Fail2Ban] nginx-limit-req: banned <ip> from <fq-hostname>
Date: `LC_ALL=C date +"%a, %d %h %Y %T %z"`
From: Fail2Ban <root@<fq-hostname>>
To: a@b.c\n
Hi,\n
The IP <ip> has just been banned by Fail2Ban after
<failures> attempts against nginx-limit-req.\n\n
Here is more information about <ip> :\n
`whois <ip> || echo "missing whois program"`\n
Regards,\n
Fail2Ban" | /usr/sbin/sendmail -f "root@<fq-hostname>" "a@b.c"

files.jail.local:
[DEFAULT]
destemail = a@b.c
maxretry = 2
[nginx-limit-req]
enabled = true
backend = gamin
logpath = /dev/null tail
maxretry = 0
bantime = 1h 30m
action = %(action_mw)s
[horde]
enabled = true
logpath = /dev/null tail
action = %(action_)s
ignoreip = example.com
[lighttpd-auth]
enabled = true
logpath = /nonexistent/%(__name__)s.log
maxretry = 0
action = hostsdeny
filter = %(__name__)s[mode=more]
ignoreip = example.com

stderr: fail2ban.jailreader: WARNING Have not found any log file for 'lighttpd-auth' jail.
